messages:
anya: FYI sales wants an accelerated MVP for a strategic pilot starting 2026-11-08. They need model pinning + predictable p99 latency. We have to decide cuts to hit their date.
jason: whats the earliest we can land pinning + SLO hooks without disrupting v1 scope?
lucy: eng estimate: 2w for manual pin+audit logs, 2w for canary automation + SLO gates. If we reallocate frontend work, we can do it in 3w but that means deferring console cost by-route and embeddings autotune to v1.
mike: ops: supportable if we add a hard rate cap for the pilot and an emergency tenant fallback toggle. fallback should switch to a safe-model variant and be runnable in <15m.
tom: product tradeoffs: deferring cost-by-route UI is fine short-term, but customers will ask for transparency. We should provide a canned report snapshot for them instead.
anya: proposal: ship manual API pin + audit logs, cut the flags/dashboard UI to v1, implement canary ramp + SLO gates + tenant fallback. include a rollback SLA in pilot T&Cs. agree?
jason: approve if legal ok with rollback wording and customers accept quality delta during fallback.
sarah-legal: recommend SLA text: documented rollback procedure + 4-hour critical remediation window. also require explicit opt-in for elevated debugging logs during pilot.
lucy: engineering will keep minimal telemetry (latency traces + 5xx) and drop cost-by-route and deep session funnels. well add an alert for p99 and error-rate thresholds.
mike: ops will implement rate caps, emergency toggle, and a tabletop run the day before onboarding. estimate 5 days for automation + tests.
deploy-bot: scheduled: pipeline "pilot/accelerate/manual-pin-canary" will run on 2026-11-04 03:00 UTC. status: queued.
anya: action items: lucy  implement manual-pin + audit logs (due 2026-11-02); mike  emergency toggle + tabletop (due 2026-11-03); jason  customer-facing pilot note (quality/rollback) (due 2026-11-01); sarah-legal  finalize SLA + logging consent (due 2026-10-31). If all green, confirm pilot start 2026-11-08.
jason: i'll draft the canned cost snapshot template for customer visibility and post it here.
lucy: note: if we reassign runtime team mid-sprint this slips. please don't move runtime owners.
anya: acknowledged. will coordinate with eng leads. Any major objections?
tom: none from product. core ask: make the rollback path visible to customers and support.
sarah-legal: i'll circulate final legal language and ping compliance for data residency check (if requested by customer).
anya: great. let's keep updates here. if any blocker appears escalate to me. :thumbsup:
